notes:
POC focused on embeddings + lightweight reranker for support KB.
Key metrics: index scope targeted 3M-8M docs (moderate), QPS target 400-800 sustained, P95 query latency goal <120ms for retrieval+rerank, cost target <= $0.003/query.
Summary from 2026-02-03 call: VP Product said, "must hit sub-100ms for short help flows at 500 qps or we lose agent adoption". Currently running Pinecone + serverless reranker baseline: observed 95p ~300ms, cost ~$0.006/query (est). Team wants a hosted API with predictable per-query economics, automatic prefix caching for KB updates, and a simple rollout path (start hosted, consider hybrid later).
Model preferences: dense embeddings (prefer open family or managed embeddings), two-stage flow: ANN candidate retrieval -> light T5-style reranker (on-device or small LLM). Need transparent token/unit billing for rerank step.
Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML in place, retention controls and audit logs mandatory; EU residency for subset of customer data.
Quoted objections from Legal: "we need proof of residency + separation for EU PII before procurement".
POC notes: Redwood POC run 2026-01-26 (1M slice): retrieval+rerank P95=115ms, avg cost $0.0027/query. SE asked for 7-day stress run at 600 qps.
Value drivers called out by customer: lower latency to improve first-response automation, predictable pricing to replace current overprovisioning.
Decision criteria: perf (P95), cost/unit, ingestion latency for fresh docs (<5min), SLA for sustained high QPS.
